CRAS C925

# 

M.2 NVMe PCIe Gen4x4 Solid State Drive

 Redefine the Future of Storage 

### Key Features

- Add-on Aluminum Heatsink Included

Free optional aluminum heatsink for improved cooling efficiency
- Intelligent SLC Caching Technology

Boost read/write speeds and enhanced durability with intelligent SLC caching algorithm
- Self-diagnostic S.M.A.R.T.

S.M.A.R.T. (Self-Monitoring, Analysis, and Reporting Technology), fault detection system for improved stability
- Enhanced Thermal Management

Self-management of thermal throttling for stable performance and extended lifespan
- LDPC ECC & Global Wear Leveling

Corrects errors, reduces premature wear, and extends the overall lifespan of the SSD
- Secure AES 256-bit Encryption

AES 256-bit encryption provides an advanced level of data protection making it the most secure way to protect your data

## Astonishing Speed for Utmost Performance 

 Harness the speed of PCIe Gen4 NVMe with read/write capabilities of up to 7400/6500 MB/s for significant productivity boost. Enhanced response and performance for gamers to creative professionals.

## Streamlined Aluminum Heatsink Design

## Compatible with PlayStation® 5 

 Expand your game collection with additional storage space, and improve your gaming experience with your drive operating at peak performance. The installation and setup process for your PlayStation®5 console is hassle-free. 

## Ultra-thin SSD with Single-sided Architecture 

 Featuring an ultra-thin, single-sided NAND chip design, the CRAS C925 is compatible with a wider range of form factors, making it particularly suitable for slim and compact devices, laptops or consoles. 

## Advanced 3D NAND Flash 

The 3D NAND flash architecture is the latest advancement in NAND technology significantly boosts storage capacity through flash memory cells stacking vertically to enhance Total Bytes Written (TBW), and improves performance.

## Supercharge Your Gaming Rig 

 The CRAS C925 offers blistering speed of up to 7400/6500 MB/s, for blazing fast responsiveness allowing you to enjoy the ultimate gaming experience without lags or delays during intense gaming sessions.

...

## Easy 3-Step Heatsink Installation 

### Take out the CRAS C925 SSD and put it on a clear surface

- Make sure the side with chips facing up

### Remove the plastic cover of adhesive tape from the bottom of heatsink

### Put the heatsink in place

- Align the heatsink onto the center of CRAS C925 SSD to cover the surface area.
- Check the alignment to make sure the heatsink doesn’t cover the gold finger and the screw cutout on both side.
- Place the heatsink onto CRAS C925 SSD.
- Press down the heatsink evenly and make it adhere to the surfaces of CRAS C925 SSD tightly & completely. 

### Includes FREE Backup & Migration Software 

 Every KLEVV CRAS C925 SSD comes with an official license for Acronis True Image. The software offers comprehensive disk-image backup features, enabling users to effortlessly restore or transfer data from their existing drive.

### KLEVV RELEASES THE ULTRA-FAST GENUINE G560 PCIE GEN5 SSD AND CRAS C715 PCIE GEN3 REFRESH

#### UNLOCK NEXT-GEN SPEED AND ENHANCED DURABILITY WITH THE LATEST SSD LINEUP

Update 24th September, 2024

September 24, 2024, Hong Kong—KLEVV, the premier consumer memory and storage brand introduced by Essencore, is keen to unveil the all-new GENUINE G560 PCIe Gen5x4 NVMe M.2 SSD and CRAS C715 PCIe Gen3x4 NVMe M.2 SSD.

...

Available in capacities of 1 TB, 2 TB, and 4 TB with superior endurance of up to 3,000 TBW, the GENUINE G560 combines power, durability, and cutting-edge design that showcases the limitless capabilities of next-generation storage technology for modern-day computing.

CRAS C715: ULTRA-COMPACT DESIGN FOR EFFICIENT PERFORMANCE

KLEVV also revamped its PCIe Gen3 SSD lineup with the new and improved KLEVV CRAS C715 SSD. CRAS C715 redefines budget-friendly excellence by combining fast PCIe Gen3 speeds with reliable storage technology, perfect for users seeking an affordable yet high-performance upgrade.

Coming in 256GB, 512GB, and 1 TB capacities, the CRAS C715 features a slim, single-sided form factor, making it ideal for compact devices such as laptops and mini-PCs, ensuring easy installation without compromising performance. Equipped with dynamic SLC caching technology, it provides rapid read/write speeds of up to 3,200/2,000 MB/s, significantly reducing system startup times, file transfers, and application load times showcasing remarkable improvements from its predecessor the CRAS C710. Advanced KLEVV technology and carefully selected 3D NAND chips ensure the CRAS C715 consistently delivers peak performance with a noteworthy TBW rating. Equipped with a cutting-edge LDPC ECC engine, the drive benefits from accelerated error correction, and global wear leveling intelligently distributes write operations to maximize its longevity. Its sophisticated thermal throttling algorithm ensures stable performance even under heavy workloads. Additionally, SMART technology provides continuous health monitoring, safeguarding the SSD’s reliability over the long term.

COMPLEMENTARY FEATURES, WARRANTY AND AVAILABILITY

Both SSDs include a complimentary copy of Acronis True Image 2023 software from KLEVV, allowing users to easily back up, clone, and protect their data with advanced disk imaging and cybersecurity features.
